params.val: prevents the move this turn (too infatuated to attack)
the Pokémon that caused the infatuation has fainted or is no longer on the field

checked independently each time the Pokémon attempts to act, same as Paralysis. Verified via Showdown source (moves.ts attract condition): can only be inflicted between a target and source of opposite gender (pokemon.gender checks in onStart/onTryImmunity) — genderless Pokémon can neither cause nor receive infatuation. This gates whether the status is applied at all, separate from the 50% move-block chance above.
